## Summary of Changes
Provide a high-level summary of what was added, updated, or fixed in this PR.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New Feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX Refinement (design tweak, typography, layout)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring (no visual changes, code cleanup)
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (adding or updating Vitest/Playwright tests)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation Update

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes without warnings
- [ ] `npm run build` generates production bundle cleanly
- [ ] Responsive UI verified across Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop breakpoints
- [ ] Accessibility verified (keyboard navigation, focus states)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or token environment variables committed
